candidate.expected_diff: None. Copy only the existing exact S0 train.py bytes to a unique trn22 sandbox. Do not edit a MAX_TRAIN_SECONDS constant, add a CLI budget flag, or change model/eval code.

cache_policy.proof_required: The root and all seven paths must be absent before staging. Privately create and prove all cache dirs empty before launch; pin documented NEURON_COMPILE_CACHE_URL to the new persistent path, with no inherited NEURON_CC_FLAGS --cache_dir override. Archive pre/post object counts and new compiler objects under that URL plus first relevant neuronx-cc logs. An empty NEURON_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR alone is not true-cold proof. Never delete or overwrite existing caches/checkpoints/artifacts.

trusted_prepare.policy: Copy only exact S0 train.py by plain scp/rsync and SHA-256 verify it on host. Import the unchanged trusted prepare.py from its existing pinned checkout via PYTHONPATH; verify both host-file and fresh-process imported prepare.__file__/SHA before training and eval. Do not copy/edit prepare.py, data, tokenizer or evaluator.

step_boundary_evidence.policy: Create a unique private empty rank-0 append-mode step log before launch, as the official runner normally supplies one. No other NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_* override may alter seed, budget, model, out dir or data. Archive raw distinct rank-0 completed boundaries, torchrun/all-worker exit proof, startup-to-fifth-boundary duration, charged training time, checkpoint metadata/hash and quiescent postflight; the trusted function logs rank 0 only.

evaluation.metric: public validation BPB at context 1024 over 20971520 tokens from the trusted evaluator; archive exact command, process identity, result JSON, checkpoint hash, token and timeout fields. This is the first cold-replay submission-safety score, not a leaderboard submission.

required_prelaunch: Independent proposal review and one-use Supervisor assignment bind this exact label, source SHA, bare command, trusted prepare SHA and distinct cold-cache paths after BOTH independently accepted smoke PASS receipts. Do not infer a PASS from an in-progress run.

trn22 116188 smoke and any intervening A2 job/training/evaluation must be fully terminal with quiescent postflight; one job per host, no Neuron process/device or host-lock holder and no dual launcher.

Verify unique S0 full label/root and all cache paths absent, disk free >=6.5 GiB plus projected headroom, no STOP/breaker, five authorized train shards/tokenizer, source/prepare SHA/import path, seed 42, default 1800-second budget and bare full-chip LNC2 x4 command.

Verify archived exact S0 bare-argv four-rank CPU G2 PASS; leave external NEURON_CC_FLAGS unset so S0 sets its baked optlevel-1/BF16 default. Pin only the documented fresh cache and rank-0 step-log instrumentation; no evaluator/data/optimizer override.

success_criteria.quality: Fresh-process trusted public20M/context1024 BPB should be compared with the historical two-run 116188 mean 0.99195377346572045 using the S0 EVIDENCE.md absolute ±0.0008 safety tolerance; a mismatch is an investigation, not an improvement or submission-ready claim. This is the first of two required cold replays.
success_criteria.throughput: Archive full training steps/tokens, startup-to-fifth-boundary duration <=840 s, charged 1800-second budget and compile-cache evidence; faster steps alone are not a BPB win.
success_criteria.correctness: Exact unmodified S0 bytes and bare launch on all four ranks, distinct completed rank-0 boundaries with synchronized collective and all-worker exit proof, no crash/NaN/over_budget, finite model-only checkpoint that strict-loads the trained GPT, effective true-cold cache proof, fresh-process public20M finite score with exact token/context/timeout fields, and clean quiescent postflight. Any missing checkpoint, budget breach, scorer failure or cold-cache proof failure is a failed/inconclusive gate, never a win.

submission_gates_remaining_after_this_fi: A passing first cold replay alone does not authorize upload. Workflow S0 EVIDENCE.md still requires a second distinct true-cold full replay within its tolerance, native 100-step S0-versus-116188 lockstep, Neuron eval-path equivalence on an S0-trained checkpoint, independent reviewer checklist/audit and separate human submission approval.
abort_conditions: Either short smoke lacks independent PASS, is failed/inconclusive, or trn22 remains occupied by train/eval/Neuron holder.
Disk free <6.5 GiB/projected need, STOP/breaker, source/prepare/G2/bare argv mismatch, unique label/root/cache collision or nonempty cold-cache path.

Inherited compiler cache override, unknown training env override, Neuron compile error, crash, NaN, missing checkpoint, nonzero all-worker/torchrun exit, over-budget or invalid fresh-process evaluation.
Any attempt to relaunch the consumed trn21 r1 or a smoke label, delete protected artifacts, alter prepare.py/data/evaluator/tokenizer, submit automatically or call an unscored/failed run a BPB gain.
